note: Every weekly meal idea, kept after its sale week ends. The grocery refresh adds each week's meals here.

recipes.name: Sticky garlic-ginger pork rib chops with charred red peppers and rice
steps: Whisk the glaze: ¼ cup soy sauce, 3 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp vinegar, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ground ginger, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 2 lb boneless country-style rib chops with 3 Tbsp of it and let sit 15 minutes. Start 1¼ cups rice.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the pork 4–5 minutes per side until browned and 145°F inside; rest on a plate 5 minutes.
In the same pan, char 2 sliced red bell peppers 3–4 minutes. Pour in the remaining glaze and 2 Tbsp water and bubble 1–2 minutes until sticky.
Slice the pork, return it to the pan and toss to coat. Serve over rice with sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Crispy citrus pork carnitas tacos with avocado crema and quick-pickled onions
steps: Heat oven to 325°F. Cut a 3 lb pork butt into 2-inch chunks and rub with 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Put in a Dutch oven with 1 quartered onion, 6 smashed garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lemon and 1 lime and 1 cup broth.
Cover and bake 2½–3 hours until fork-tender. Meanwhile, quick-pickle 1 thinly sliced red onion in ½ cup vinegar, ½ cup hot water, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt.
Shred the pork, spread on a sheet pan with 1 Tbsp oil and ½ cup of the cooking juices, and broil 5–7 minutes until the edges crisp.
Mash 1 avocado with ½ cup sour cream, juice of ½ lime and a pinch of salt for crema. Warm 12 tortillas and fill with pork, crema, the second avocado sliced, pickled onions and cilantro.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan chicken with mushrooms, white beans and toasted sourdough

ingredients.item: Great Northern or cannellini beans, 15.5 oz
Simply Nature organic chicken broth, 32 oz

steps: Halve 2 lb chicken breasts into thin cutlets and season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Sear in 1 Tbsp oil over medium-high 4–5 minutes per side until 165°F; set aside.
Add 1 Tbsp butter and 8 oz sliced mushrooms; cook 5 minutes until browned. Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp tomato paste and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup broth, 1 cup half & half and 1 drained can white beans; simmer 4 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in ½ cup grated cheese and the spinach until wilted.
Return the chicken to the sauce to warm through. Serve with toasted sourdough slices for dunking.

recipes.name: Honey-garlic lemon butter salmon with crispy roasted Brussels sprouts

ingredients.item: Fresh Atlantic salmon fillet portions, skin-on

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss 2 lb halved Brussels sprouts with 2 Tbsp oil, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper; roast cut-side down 20–25 minutes until deeply browned. Start 1¼ cups rice.
Melt 2 Tbsp butter with 3 Tbsp honey, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp soy sauce, the juice of 1 lemon and a pinch of red pepper flakes.
Lay 2 lb salmon portions skin-side down on a lined sheet pan, season with salt and pepper and spoon half the honey butter over them. Bake 10–12 minutes until 145°F and flaky.
Spoon the remaining honey butter over the salmon, add lemon wedges and serve with the sprouts and rice.

recipes.name: Cajun dirty rice with ground beef, andouille and peppers
steps: Brown 1 lb ground beef and 12 oz sliced andouille in a large pot over medium-high, breaking up the beef, until the beef reaches 160°F, about 7 minutes.

Add 1 Tbsp butter, 1 diced onion, 2 diced bell peppers and 2 diced celery ribs; cook 5 minutes. Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, thyme and oregano, ½ tsp cayenne, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.
Add 1½ cups rice, 2½ cups broth and 1 Tbsp Worcestershire. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, fluff, and finish with sliced green onions and hot sauce to taste.

recipes.name: Roasted butternut squash and white bean pasta with sage brown butter (meatless)

ingredients.item: Great Northern or cannellini beans, 15.5 oz

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss a 2½ lb butternut squash, peeled and cut into ¾-inch cubes, with 2 Tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Roast 25–30 minutes until caramelized.
Cook 1 lb pasta in well-salted water; save 1 cup pasta water before draining.
In the pasta pot, melt 4 Tbsp butter over medium and cook until nutty and golden, 3 minutes. Add 10 sage leaves, 3 sliced garlic cloves, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and a pinch of nutmeg for 1 minute.
Add the pasta, squash, 1 drained can white beans, ½ cup grated cheese and ½ cup pasta water; toss until glossy. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and more cheese.

recipes.name: Greek lemon-oregano drumsticks with crispy potatoes and cucumber yogurt sauce

ingredients.item: Bowl & Basket russet or yellow potatoes, 5 lb bag

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Whisk ¼ cup olive oil, juice and zest of 1 lemon, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.
Toss 10 drumsticks (about 3 lb) and 3 lb potatoes cut into wedges with the marinade and spread on two sheet pans.
Roast 40–45 minutes, turning once, until the potatoes are crisp and the chicken reaches 165°F (175°F is even more tender for drumsticks).
Grate 2 mini cucumbers, squeeze dry and stir into 1 cup Greek yogurt with 1 small grated garlic clove, 1 tsp dill, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Serve with the chicken and potatoes.

recipes.name: Cuban mojo roast pork loin with pineapple-avocado salsa, black beans and rice
steps: Make mojo: juice of 1 orange and 1 lime, ¼ cup olive oil, 6 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Marinate a 2½ lb piece of pork loin in it at least 1 hour (or overnight).
Heat oven to 400°F. Sear the pork in a hot oven-safe skillet 2 minutes per side, pour the marinade over it and roast 35–45 minutes until 145°F. Rest 10 minutes. Start 1¼ cups rice.
Warm 2 drained cans black beans with 1 garlic clove, ½ tsp cumin and a splash of water.
Dice ½ pineapple and 2 avocados; toss with cilantro, juice of 1 lime, a pinch of red pepper flakes and salt. Slice the pork, spoon the pan juices over it and serve with rice, beans and salsa.

recipes.name: Chicken thigh cacciatore with blistered vine tomatoes over pasta

ingredients.item: Bowl & Basket chicken drumsticks or thighs

steps: Season 3 lb bone-in chicken thighs with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Brown skin-side down in 1 Tbsp oil in a deep skillet over medium-high, 6–7 minutes; flip and brown 2 minutes. Set aside.

Pour off all but 1 Tbsp fat. Cook 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced bell pepper 5 minutes, then 4 garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 30 seconds. Add 1½ lb chopped vine tomatoes, ½ cup broth and 1 Tbsp balsamic.
Nestle in the chicken skin-side up, cover and simmer 25–30 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F (175°F is more tender) and the tomatoes collapse into a sauce.
Cook 1 lb pasta. Serve the chicken and sauce over it with grated Parmesan.

recipes.name: Chipotle-style turkey burrito bowls with fresh tomato-avocado salsa
steps: Cook 1¼ cups rice; stir in the juice of 1 lime and a handful of chopped cilantro.

Brown 2 lb ground turkey with 1 diced onion in 1 Tbsp oil over medium-high until 165°F, about 8 minutes. Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 Tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp salt and ⅓ cup water; simmer 3 minutes.
Warm 1 drained can black beans. Dice 1 lb tomatoes and 2 avocados and toss with cilantro, juice of 1 lime and salt.
Build bowls with rice, turkey, beans, salsa and shredded cheese; add hot sauce to taste.

recipes.name: Cajun shrimp & sausage skillet with peppers over rice

ingredients.item: Bowl & Basket Italian sausage, family pack

steps: Mix a Cajun rub: 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, oregano and thyme, ½ tsp cayenne, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Toss 1 lb peeled shrimp with half of it. Start 1½ cups rice.
Brown 1 lb Italian sausage (casings removed, in chunks) in 1 Tbsp oil over medium-high heat until 160°F, about 6–8 minutes. Lift out.

In the drippings, cook 2 sliced bell peppers and 1 sliced onion 5 minutes. Add 4 minced garlic cloves and the rest of the rub for 30 seconds, then a 14.5 oz can tomatoes and ½ cup broth; simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the sausage and shrimp and cook 3–4 minutes until the shrimp are pink and opaque. Swirl in 1 Tbsp butter and a few dashes hot sauce; serve over rice with sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Honey-soy glazed pork tenderloin with garlic egg fried rice

ingredients.item: Land O'Lakes cage-free large eggs, dozen

steps: Whisk 3 Tbsp honey, 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 3 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp ginger, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp sriracha. Coat a 1¼ lb pork tenderloin with a third of it.
Sear the pork in 1 Tbsp oil in an oven-safe skillet 2 minutes per side, then roast at 425°F for 15–18 minutes until 145°F, brushing with another third of the glaze halfway. Rest 5 minutes and slice.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet over high heat, scramble 3 eggs in 1 Tbsp oil and push aside. Add 1 diced bell pepper and 2 minced garlic cloves for 2 minutes, then 4 cups cold cooked rice, the peas and 2 Tbsp soy sauce; fry until hot and a little crispy.
Finish the rice with 1 tsp sesame oil and sliced green onions. Simmer the last of the glaze 1 minute and drizzle over the sliced pork.

recipes.name: Skillet chicken parmesan with garlicky spaghetti

ingredients.item: Boneless skinless chicken breasts, family pack (about 4.2 lb)

steps: Slice 2 lb chicken breasts in half horizontally into cutlets. Season with salt, pepper and 1 tsp Italian seasoning, then press into ½ cup bread crumbs mixed with ¼ cup Parmesan.
Brown the cutlets in 2 Tbsp olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet, 3 minutes per side. Set aside.

In the same pan, cook 5 sliced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes in 1 Tbsp oil for 1 minute. Add two 14.5 oz cans crushed or diced tomatoes, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt; simmer 8 minutes.
Nestle the chicken in the sauce, top with 2 cups shredded mozzarella and ¼ cup Parmesan and bake at 425°F for 12–15 minutes until bubbly and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Meanwhile cook 12 oz spaghetti; toss with a few spoonfuls of the sauce. Serve the chicken over the pasta with basil.

recipes.name: Smoky beef & sweet potato taco skillet with avocado-lime crema
steps: Dice 1½ lb sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Cook in 1 Tbsp oil in a large covered skillet over medium heat 10–12 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.
Push them aside, add 1½ lb ground beef and 1 diced onion and cook, breaking up, until the beef reaches 160°F; drain most of the fat.

Stir in 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp oregano and 1 tsp salt for 1 minute, then a 14.5 oz can diced tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes until thick; sprinkle with 1 cup shredded cheese and cover to melt.
Blend or mash 2 avocados with ½ cup sour cream, the juice of 1 lime, a few dashes hot sauce and a pinch of salt. Spoon the filling into warm tortillas and top with crema and cilantro.

recipes.name: Lemon-garlic roast chicken with crispy potatoes and pan gravy

ingredients.item: Bowl & Basket russet or yellow potatoes, 5 lb bag

steps: Pat a 5 lb chicken very dry. Mash 3 Tbsp soft butter with 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp onion powder, the zest of 1 lemon, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper; rub under and over the skin. Put the halved lemon inside.
Toss 3 lb potatoes, cut in 1½-inch chunks, with 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp thyme and spread around the chicken in a roasting pan or large sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 70–80 minutes, stirring the potatoes once, until the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F. Rest 15 minutes; move the potatoes back to the oven to crisp.
For gravy, whisk 2 Tbsp flour into 2 Tbsp pan drippings over medium heat 1 minute, then whisk in 1½ cups broth and a squeeze of the roasted lemon; simmer until thick.

recipes.name: Lemon-oregano pork chops with blistered tomatoes and spinach orzo
steps: Season 2 lb pork chops with 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper and the zest of 1 lemon.
Sear in 1 Tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat 4–5 minutes per side until 145°F; rest on a plate.

In the same pan, cook 1 lb halved tomatoes and 1 sliced red onion in 1 Tbsp oil until the tomatoes blister and slump, 5 minutes. Add 3 sliced garlic cloves, a pinch of red pepper flakes, the lemon juice and ¼ cup broth; scrape up the browned bits.
Meanwhile cook 8 oz orzo, drain and stir in a big handful of spinach, 1 Tbsp butter, 1 Tbsp olive oil and salt. Serve the chops over the orzo with the tomato pan sauce spooned on top.

recipes.name: Smoky shakshuka with peppers and crusty bread (meatless)

ingredients.item: Land O'Lakes cage-free large eggs, dozen

steps: Cook 1 sliced onion and 2 sliced bell peppers in 3 Tbsp olive oil over medium heat until soft and sweet, 8–10 minutes.

Add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1½ tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp chili powder and a pinch of red pepper flakes for 1 minute. Stir in two 14.5 oz cans tomatoes, 1 tsp sugar and ¾ tsp salt; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make 8 wells and crack in 8 eggs. Cover and cook on low 6–8 minutes until the whites are fully set (yolks as firm as you like; fully cooked is 160°F).
Sprinkle with herbs and black pepper and serve straight from the pan with toasted bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Balsamic-garlic pot roast with mushrooms

ingredients.item: Simply Nature organic chicken broth, 32 oz

steps: Season a 3 lb chuck roast with 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Sear in 2 Tbsp oil in a Dutch oven 4–5 minutes per side; set aside.

Cook 1 sliced onion and 16 oz halved mushrooms 5 minutes. Stir in 6 smashed garlic cloves, 2 Tbsp tomato paste and 2 Tbsp flour for 1 minute, then 2 cups broth, 3 Tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp thyme and 1 tsp Italian seasoning.
Return the roast, cover and braise at 325°F for 2½ hours. Add 2 lb halved potatoes and 1 lb carrots in chunks and cook 45–60 minutes more until everything is fork-tender.
Shred or slice the beef and spoon the thick balsamic-mushroom gravy over the top.

recipes.name: Honey-mustard kielbasa, Brussels sprouts & apple sheet pan with crispy white beans

ingredients.item: Great Northern or cannellini beans, 15.5 oz

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss 2 lb halved Brussels sprouts with 1½ Tbsp oil, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp salt and pepper; roast 12 minutes.

Add a 14 oz kielbasa cut in coins, 2 Gala apples in wedges and 2 cans drained, patted-dry white beans tossed with ½ Tbsp oil, ½ tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp thyme. Roast 15 minutes more, until the beans crisp and the kielbasa browns (it's precooked; heat to 165°F).
Whisk 2 Tbsp mustard, 2 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar and a pinch of red pepper flakes; drizzle over the hot pan and toss.

recipes.name: Chili-lime salmon tacos with avocado and lime slaw

ingredients.item: Fresh Atlantic salmon fillet portions, skin-on

steps: Mix 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp brown sugar and 1 tsp salt. Rub over 1½ lb salmon.
Roast on an oiled sheet pan at 425°F for 10–12 minutes until it flakes and reaches 145°F; flake into chunks, discarding the skin.
Toss 3 cups coleslaw mix with the juice of 1 lime, a pinch of salt and chopped cilantro. Stir ½ cup sour cream with the juice of ½ lime and a few dashes hot sauce.
Warm 8 tortillas and fill with salmon, slaw, sliced avocado (2) and the spicy lime crema.

recipes.name: Sticky soy-ginger drumsticks with garlicky broccoli
steps: Whisk ¼ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup honey, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger, 1 Tbsp sriracha, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 3 lb drumsticks in half of it.
Bake on a foil-lined sheet at 425°F for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until 165°F (175°F+ is even more tender).
Simmer the remaining sauce 2–3 minutes until syrupy and brush over the chicken; broil 2 minutes to caramelize.
Roast 2 lb broccoli florets with 2 Tbsp oil, 2 sliced garlic cloves and salt at 425°F for 15 minutes. Serve with rice and sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Spicy garlic meatball pasta bake
steps: Boil 1 lb pasta 2 minutes short of the package time; drain.

In a large oven-safe skillet, warm 2 Tbsp olive oil with 5 sliced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute. Add a 28 oz can crushed tomatoes, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Add the 20 oz meatballs and simmer 10 minutes until heated to 165°F. Stir in the pasta and ⅓ cup Parmesan.
Top with 2 cups shredded cheese and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until bubbly and browned.

recipes.name: Smoky pumpkin beef chili
steps: Brown 2 lb ground beef with 1 diced red onion until cooked to 160°F; drain off most of the fat.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves, 3 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and ¼ tsp cinnamon; stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add a can of pumpkin, a can of diced tomatoes, 2 cans drained beans, 1 cup water with 1 tsp beef bouillon, 1 Tbsp brown sugar and a few dashes of hot sauce.
Simmer 25–30 minutes; season with salt. Top with shredded cheese, sour cream and more red onion.

recipes.name: Sausage with Boursin cheesy grits and garlicky greens

ingredients.item: Jimmy Dean pork sausage patties, 24 ct
Boursin cheese variety pack, 3 x 5.3 oz
1 bunch kale or a bag of spinach

steps: Bring 2 cups broth and 2 cups water to a boil; whisk in 1 cup quick grits and cook 5–7 minutes, stirring.
Stir in a 5.3 oz Boursin, 2 Tbsp butter and plenty of pepper until creamy.
Cook 8 sausage patties in a skillet 3–4 minutes a side until 160°F; set aside.
In the same pan, sauté chopped greens with 3 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of red pepper flakes until wilted. Serve over the grits with the sausage and a few dashes of hot sauce.

recipes.name: Lemon-oregano chicken thighs with blistered tomatoes
steps: Marinate 2½ lb chicken thighs at least 15 minutes in 3 Tbsp olive oil, zest and juice of 1 lemon, 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes and 1½ tsp salt.
Spread on a sheet pan with 1 lb halved tomatoes and 1 red onion cut into wedges.
Roast at 425°F for 22–25 minutes until the chicken hits 165°F and the tomatoes burst.
Splash 1 Tbsp red wine vinegar over the pan juices, stir, and spoon everything over rice or orzo.

recipes.name: Hot-honey crispy chicken sandwiches with spicy mayo
steps: Bake about 1½ lb crispy chicken strips at 400°F for 18–20 minutes until crisp and 165°F.
Warm ⅓ cup honey with 2 Tbsp hot sauce and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute; toss with the hot chicken.
Stir ½ cup mayo with 1 Tbsp hot sauce, ½ tsp garlic powder and ½ tsp smoked paprika.
Butter and toast the buns, spread with spicy mayo, and stack lettuce, chicken and pickles.

recipes.name: Ginger-garlic potsticker soup

ingredients.item: Ling Ling chicken & vegetable potstickers, 4.2 lb
Swanson less-sodium chicken broth, 6 x 32 oz

steps: Simmer 8 cups chicken broth with 4 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger (or 1 Tbsp fresh) and 2 Tbsp soy sauce for 5 minutes.
Add about 24 frozen potstickers and simmer 6–8 minutes until heated through to 165°F.
Stir in chopped bok choy or spinach for the last 2 minutes, then 1 Tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp sesame oil.
Serve topped with green onions and a spoonful of chili crisp or sriracha.

recipes.name: Garlic-herb butter pork loin with pan gravy
steps: Mash 3 Tbsp soft butter with 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp crushed rosemary, 1 Tbsp Dijon, 1½ tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Rub all over a 3 lb pork loin.
Sear in an oiled oven-safe skillet on all sides, then roast at 375°F for 40–50 minutes until 145°F. Rest 10 minutes.
Meanwhile boil peeled potatoes 15–18 minutes and mash with butter and salt.
For gravy, whisk 2 Tbsp flour into the pan drippings over medium heat for 1 minute, then whisk in 2 cups broth and simmer until thick. Slice the pork and spoon gravy over everything.

recipes.name: Crispy citrus pork carnitas tacos with pickled red onions
steps: Cut a 3.5 lb pork butt into 2-inch chunks. Rub with 1 Tbsp cumin, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp oregano, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp salt and 6 smashed garlic cloves.
Put in a Dutch oven with ½ cup orange juice and the juice of 1 lime. Cover and bake at 300°F for 3–3½ hours until fork-tender (well past the 145°F safe temp).
Meanwhile, thinly slice 1 red onion and cover with ½ cup cider vinegar, ½ cup hot water, 1 Tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt; let sit 30 minutes.
Shred the pork, spread on a sheet pan, spoon over some juices and broil 4–5 minutes until the edges crisp.
Pile into warm tortillas with sliced avocado, pickled onions, cilantro and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Brown-butter pumpkin cream tortellini (meatless)
steps: Cook 2 packages tortellini per the package; save ½ cup pasta water.
Melt 4 Tbsp butter until nutty and golden, 3–4 minutes, with 8 sage leaves (crisp them, then lift out). Add 3 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds.
Whisk in 1 cup pumpkin, ¾ cup heavy cream, ½ cup broth, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, ½ tsp salt and plenty of pepper; simmer 3 minutes.
Toss in the tortellini with ½ cup Parmesan, loosening with pasta water. Top with the crispy sage.

recipes.name: Blackened salmon with honey-lime butter and apple slaw
steps: Mix 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, thyme and brown sugar, ¼ tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Pat 1½ lb salmon dry and coat the tops.
Sear seasoned-side down in a hot oiled cast-iron skillet 3 minutes, flip and cook 3–4 more until it reaches 145°F.
Stir together 3 Tbsp soft butter, 1 tsp honey and the zest and juice of 1 lime; spoon over the hot salmon.
Toss coleslaw mix with 1 thinly sliced Honeycrisp, a little thin-sliced red onion, 3 Tbsp mayo, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar and a pinch of salt. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sticky honey-garlic chicken over rice
steps: Toss 1.5 lb chicken tenders with 1 Tbsp cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Sear in a hot oiled skillet until golden, 3–4 minutes a side.
Stir together ⅓ cup honey, ¼ cup soy sauce, 4 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp ginger and a squeeze of sriracha. Pour it in and simmer 2–3 minutes until glossy and the chicken hits 165°F.
Serve over rice and top with sliced green onions.

recipes.name: Smoky chicken tacos with quick-pickled onions
steps: Thinly slice a red onion and cover with ½ cup warm vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt. Let it sit while you cook.
Rub 1.5 lb chicken tenders with 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp each cumin, smoked paprika and garlic powder, plus salt.
Sear 3–4 minutes a side until 165°F, then slice.
Mash 2 mini avocados with lime juice, salt and a spoon of sour cream for a quick crema.
Pile into warm tortillas with cheese, pickled onions and the avocado crema.

recipes.name: Sausage & apple skillet with cider-mustard sauce
steps: Brown the sausage links in a skillet, then slice into coins and keep cooking until done (160°F).
Add sliced apples and onion with a pat of butter and cook until soft and caramelized, 6–8 minutes.
Stir in 1 Tbsp mustard, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp brown sugar, ½ tsp thyme and a splash of water to make a glossy sauce.
Serve with roasted potatoes or over rice.

recipes.name: Lemon-garlic butter salmon with roasted broccoli
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss 1.5 lb broccoli florets with oil, garlic powder, salt and a pinch of pepper flakes; roast 15 minutes.
Season 1.5 lb salmon with salt, pepper and ½ tsp smoked paprika. Push the broccoli to the side and add the salmon to the pan.
Melt 3 Tbsp butter with 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 Tbsp lemon juice; spoon over the salmon.
Roast 10–12 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily and reaches 145°F. Serve with rice or potatoes.

recipes.name: Korean-style ground beef rice bowls
steps: Brown 2 lb ground beef with a chopped red onion; drain the fat.
Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add ⅓ cup soy sauce, ¼ cup brown sugar, 1 Tbsp sesame oil and a pinch of pepper flakes. Simmer 2–3 minutes.
Serve over rice with green onions, sliced cucumber and a fried egg on top if you like.

recipes.name: Crispy sesame tofu fried rice
steps: Press the tofu for 10 minutes, cube it, toss with 2 Tbsp cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Pan-fry in oil until crispy on all sides, then toss with 1 Tbsp soy sauce and 1 Tbsp honey. Set aside.
In the same pan, scramble 2 eggs, then add frozen veggies, garlic and 3 cups cold rice. Fry until hot.
Season with soy sauce and a drizzle of sesame oil, fold the tofu back in, and top with green onions.

recipes.name: Creamy garlic-tomato chicken cavatappi
steps: Cook the pasta; save a cup of pasta water.
Season bite-size chicken with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and brown in butter until 165°F. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook 5 minced garlic cloves and a pinch of red pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then add 3 chopped tomatoes and cook until they slump.
Add 1 cup cream and ½ cup broth, simmer 3 minutes, then stir in 1 cup shredded cheese until melted.
Toss in the pasta, chicken and a handful of spinach. Loosen with pasta water as needed.

recipes.name: Brown-sugar Dijon pork loin with roasted pears
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix 3 Tbsp mustard, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme, salt and pepper.
Brown a 3 lb piece of pork loin on all sides in an oven-safe pan, then spread the mustard glaze over the top.
Scatter quartered pears and onion wedges around it and roast 35–45 minutes, until the pork reads 145°F.
Rest 10 minutes. Splash a little cider vinegar into the pan juices, stir, and spoon over the sliced pork and pears.
